build_bm_graph_builder: build a BMGraphBuilder instance to construct a probabilistic program graph with memoized nodes
create_distribution_nodes: create Bernoulli, Normal, Gamma, Dirichlet, or Beta distribution nodes using add_bernoulli, add_normal, add_gamma, add_dirichlet, add_beta methods
add_constant_values: add constant scalar or tensor values to the graph using add_constant, add_real, add_natural, add_boolean, add_constant_tensor
build_operator_nodes: build arithmetic, comparison, or matrix operator nodes using add_addition, add_multiplication, add_greater_than, add_matrix_multiplication
traverse_graph_nodes: traverse all nodes in topological order using all_nodes or all_ancestor_nodes and retrieve observations with all_observations
